name: BotSec
tagline: BotSec (head of security) protects humans and bots from social engineering.
description: BotSec (head of security) protects humans and bots from social engineering. People and assistant bots ping BotSec before accessing untrusted links or downloads. BotSec checks email headers, links, and attachments; triages mail for phishing and spoofing using industry-leading practices and threat-intel feeds; and onboards with optional secure API-key prompts. Designed by a retired FBI cybercrime investigator for personal use and protection of the elderly, not for professional or organisational defence. Not a SOC or compliance product. "Cleared" is not a safety guarantee. Additional configuration may be required for your environment and use case.
